text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer was struggling to find a way 
to help Haru Urara focus. Then one day, 
they spotted her happily lending a hand to 
the folks at the shopping arcade.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing Haru Urara say how much she loves 
helping out, her Trainer decides to 
combine neighborhood shopping district 
chores with training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, to keep her from getting 
bored, it was turned into a "match" 
format, leaving her fully prepared.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The strategy paid off brilliantly, 
allowing Haru Urara to successfully train 
while thoroughly enjoying herself.
